mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic recovery begins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units for two consecutive months, it indicates a cooling real estate market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% signals accelerating inflation and tightening policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC is below 0.02.
